value: GA3 raised germination of seeds at 4 C to 83.7% at every dose tried (50, 100, 200 mg/L), with the Discussion saying the effect at 200 mg/L 'became negative' (Results and Table 2 still show improvement at all three); KT alone at 20 mg/L gave 82.7%; 100 mg/L GA3 + 10 mg/L KT worked best (initial germination 36.2 to 25.3 d, T50 55.3 to 42.3 d); KNO3 (1, 2, 4 mg/L) gave 75.6% total germination, called not significant in the Discussion; untreated seeds on a 20 d chill stayed below 27.5% against 38.6% with 100 mg/L GA3
method: seeds in Petri dishes (100 seeds, 3 replicates) soaked in GA3, kinetin, KNO3 or water and held at 4 C; germination scored as cotyledonary petiole emergence of 1-2 mm; one-way ANOVA with Duncan's test
conditions: the paper prints the species as Tulipa thianschanica Regel, a synonym of Tulipa iliensis in WFO; the temperature test ran in the dark but the light condition of the GA3/KT/KNO3 test is not stated; GA3 x KT interaction p < 0.001; no control percentage is given for the plain GA3 test in the text read; seeds do not germinate above 16 C (80.7% at constant 4 C, 55.6% at 4/16 C, 18.3% at 4/8 C); seed coat removal made no difference (85.0% intact and coatless at 4 C after 60 d); sowing-depth results (82.4% at 1.5 cm in the abstract, 71.3% in 2018 Results) not carried

value: seeds primed 24 h in 3% KNO3 (-1.35 MPa) germinated faster and more fully than unprimed seeds (means over 4 and 10 C: T50 37.31 d against 44.85 d, MGT 38.11 against 44.36 d, germination index 14.05 against 9.26, germination 99.16% against 95.92%, all significant at p <= 0.05 by SNK); KNO3 did not differ from hydro-priming (T50 38.57 d, GP 99.25%) or PEG 8000 priming (T50 36.76 d, GP 99.50%), so the gain is a priming effect with no nitrate-specific part shown
method: 3 replicate dishes of 100 seeds per treatment, seeds disinfected in 10% H2O2, primed 24 h at 4 C in the dark in KNO3, distilled water or PEG 8000 or left unprimed, dried 24 h at 20 C, then germinated in the dark at 4, 10 and 20 C; two-way ANOVA with SNK separation
conditions: no seed germinated at 20 C in any treatment, so the means cover 4 and 10 C only; priming x temperature was significant for T50, MGT and germination index but not for synchrony (Z) or germination percentage; the best cell was hydro-priming at 10 C (T50 34.9 d), not KNO3; per-temperature KNO3 values sit in Figure 1, which was not read; germination at 10 C against 4 C was 97.83% against 98.25%, not different; seeds collected June 2018 near Metaponto, Italy

value: GA3 sprayed on dormant corms induced flowering in 2-year-old corms (11.1 to 63.9% across 500 to 2,000 ppm against 8.3% with water; 3-year-old untreated controls flowered 80.6%), but bulbils flowered 1.7 to 6.7% and 1-year corms 2.8 to 16.7% whatever the dose (0% untreated); abnormal inflorescences were 100% in bulbils, 50 to 100% in 1-year corms and 43 to 67% in 2-year corms; GA3 also lengthened the last sheath (6.5 cm at 0 ppm to 16.0-16.7 cm at 1,000 to 2,000 ppm in 2-year corms) and caused sheaths bearing leaflets and disturbed petiole geotropism
method: completely randomised field trial in Bogor, Indonesia: three replicates of 12 corms or 20 bulbils per age and dose, GA3 at 0, 500, 1000, 1500 or 2000 ppm hand-sprayed to the bud and corm on 2 August 2015, planted at 5 cm depth; ANOVA with LSD at 5%
conditions: the per-dose flowering percentages are in Table 1 (an image) and were not read; the text gives no significance test for the flowering percentages themselves; time to anthesis (92.4 to 102.1 d) was not affected by GA3 or corm age; the authors recommend 1500 ppm on 2-year corms and say 1000 and 1500 ppm avoided the seed-failure pattern of 1-year corms; study ran May 2015 to August 2016

value: seedlings kept 10 months on P723 medium under 24/0 h light/dark reached 0.68 g fresh weight and under 16/8 h 0.66 g, against 0.35 g in constant darkness (the two lit regimes did not differ); dark seedlings had the longest leaves (17.52 mm against 9.25 mm at 24/0 and 6.07 mm at 16/8) and showed etiolation; leaf number was highest at 16/8 (3.34 against 2.90 at 24/0 and 2.57 in the dark); root number was higher only at 24/0 (3.47 against 2.93 and 2.67) and root length did not separate 24/0 from the dark
method: 94 seedlings (stages 3 to 4) moved to test tubes with 13 mL P723 medium and held 10 months under T5 fluorescent light at three photoperiods; SAS GLM ANOVA with Waller-Duncan at P = 0.05
conditions: the Methods call the middle regime 18/6 h but the Results and Table 2 call it 16/8 h; seedlings per treatment and replicate number are not stated; no p-values or error terms are printed; the light test was run on P723 only (not M551 or Knudson C); seeds themselves were germinated in the dark (0/24 h) at 25 C and light against dark germination was not compared; the protocol was also applied to eight other Spiranthes taxa, which are not carried here
